sheet_prompts.a:
STYLE REFERENCE (attached image): The attached image is an already-approved unit from the SAME game (horseman). Match ONLY its hand-painted 2D art style, bold dark ink outline weight, flat cel shading with soft highlights, earthy colour richness, silhouette readability at 48 pixels, flat #FF00FF magenta background, and saturated pure-red (#E01010) team-colour convention. DO NOT copy that character, silhouette, outfit, weapon, mount, or vehicle — draw a completely different unit matching the specification below.

I am making art for ONE unit in a family-friendly historical strategy game. Draw ONE image: the master design of this unit.
Every later image of this unit will be drawn from it, and the game will animate this drawing by cutting it into parts, so it
must follow the pose rules exactly.

THE UNIT: Cuirassier. A gunpowder-era heavy cavalry cuirassier, imposing and heavily armed, on a very dark horse with a black mane and tail. The rider wears a full polished steel cuirass (breastplate and backplate) with brass rivets and a brass-trimmed gorget, a red coat with brass buttons and a red sash, a steel pot helmet with a wide peak and a tall black plume, steel pauldrons and gauntlets, buff breeches and tall black riding boots. He holds a large long-barrelled flintlock pistol with a brass-trimmed wooden grip raised in his right hand as his main weapon, with a sheathed broadsword at his hip. Twin pistol holsters and a short carbine are strapped to the front of the saddle. The horse wears a red saddle cloth edged in cream and brass under a brown leather saddle, and a brown leather bridle with brass rings.

STYLE: clean hand-painted 2D game art, bold dark outline, flat cel shading with soft highlights, earthy saturated palette,
friendly readable proportions that still read when the unit is 48 pixels tall. No photorealism, no 3D-render look, no pixel art.

VIEW: strict side view, facing RIGHT. The whole unit is inside the image with empty space of about a tenth of the image on
every side. No ground, floor, shadow, scenery, text, labels, border or effects.

BACKGROUND: one completely flat, uniform solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) background filling the entire image behind the unit. NO transparency checkerboard, NO grey-and-white grid, NO gradient, NO drop shadow, NO ambient glow, NO vignette, NO soft semi-transparent edges. Every outline, smoke puff, flame, dust cloud, or effect must be 100% solid, opaque, and hard-edged with a clean dark ink outline against the #FF00FF magenta so nothing blends into purple. Put nothing magenta, pink, or purple anywhere on the unit.

TEAM COLOUR: paint the rider's coat and the saddle cloth saturated pure red (#E01010). That is the ONLY red or red-orange anywhere in the image.
Everything else (the animal's coat, mane and hooves, skin, leather, wood, metal) is brown, tan, grey, black, white, bronze or dull dark maroon. The game recolours that red to
each player's colour, so any other red would change colour too.

POSE FOR ANIMATION (the most important part):
- The animal stands square on one ground line: all four legs straight and vertical, every hoof flat, and a clear gap between
  each pair of neighbouring legs. Seen from the side the four legs read as four separate posts; no leg overlaps another.
- The tail hangs free, ends well above the hooves and does not touch the hind legs. The head is up, the neck arched.
- The horse is a very dark cool brown-black (about #2E2A2A) with a black mane and tail (about #151515) and dark legs. It must not look red: no reddish, mahogany, rust or bay tones anywhere on the horse, because the game recolours red.
- The rider sits upright. His feet, weapon, saddle cloth and any fringe all stay above the animal's knees.
- He holds the large flintlock pistol upright in his right hand, the barrel pointing up and slightly forward, the pistol clearly large and prominent.

Generate the image now with crisp opaque edges on flat solid #FF00FF magenta.
